strings.sys.journal.person.lev.name: Lev Sokolov
strings.sys.journal.person.lev.note: Archivist at the Karsk goods office. Keeps carbons, even of pages that officially don’t exist. Wants to be on no paper.
strings.sys.journal.person.marta.name: Marta Vogel
strings.sys.journal.person.marta.note: Drives the first tram on Route 74 round the cleared blocks. Sees who is taken away at night – and says so only when she must.
strings.sys.journal.person.registrar.name: Registrar Fengler
strings.sys.journal.person.registrar.note: Enquiries and Verification at the South Branch. Releases files only in exchange for a name. There must be order.
